newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Televisa started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Televisa started as buy.

text.p: ING Barings began coverage of Mexican media giant Televisa on Wednesday with a buy rating, the firm said in a statement.

"Although Televisa shares trade at a substantial premium to the Mexican market on a price earnings and price to cash flow basis, we believe the company deserves a premium reflecting its dominant position in the Mexican media market and its unique franchise and asset value," analyst Marla Marron wrote.
She added that the company's earnings and cash flow are expected to rise in coming years.
Marron highlighted the experience of new management team Emilio Azcrraga Jean and Guillermo Caedo White, appointed after former chairman Emilio Azcrraga Milmo stepped down earlier this week.
"The recent management change is unlikely to have a significant impact on Televisa's near-term operations," she said.

The brokerage's target price for the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) is $32. In early trade Wednesday, Televisa ADRs were up 3/8 at 25-3/8, and the company's Mexican shares were up 1.5 at 101 pesos.
